originalAlarm.description: Value stored to 'thisopt' is never read

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports 'thisopt = SSL_PROTOCOL_TLSV1_1' (line 13) as a dead store when HAVE_TLSV1_X is true. In the simplified file, thisopt is assigned the SSL_PROTOCOL_TLSV1_1 value but never subsequently used (the function returns without reading it). In the real Apache ssl_cmd_protocol_parse() code, thisopt is used in protocol flag bitmask logic after this assignment. The simplified file stripped those subsequent uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug is UndeclaredIdentifier (SSL_PROTOCOL_TLSV1_1 used when !HAVE_TLSV1_X) — the opposite configuration.
